description: make autonomous Supervisor findings Vietnamese by embedding the repository STE-lite writing contract into persistent Supervisor instructions and every per-case/retry prompt while preserving the existing English-shaped machine contract: keep JSON fields, enum values, rule ids, technical names, field paths, runtime locators, and normative _RULE_CONTRACTS unchanged; require observation, evidence items, and open_question_for_lead to be concise Vietnamese human-facing text; persist a SHA-256 fingerprint of SUPERVISOR_AGENTS so upgraded workspaces recreate stale persistent Supervisor sessions and load the new instruction contract; and add regression/docs/workspace checks for the bilingual contract boundary
